ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Which letter in the diagram shows the adult stage?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a butterfly life cycle diagram, with arrows around it connecting different stages, and labeled with letters A, B, C, D, E. The picture on the left near D shows a cluster of eggs on a leaf; the picture above near B shows a caterpillar/larva; the picture on the right near C shows the pupa/chrysalis stage; the picture at the bottom near E shows a complete butterfly with wings. Reasoning: The adult stage of a butterfly is the winged butterfly, not the egg, larva, or pupa. The letter next to the complete adult butterfly in the diagram is E, so the adult stage corresponds to E.
